verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review suggests fixes that can be applied in one click from the review page, and its own Agent can make changes from the PR page and open draft PRs. GT MCP connects external AI agents to Graphite, but only for creating stacked PRs, not for passing review findings to them. Missing for 10: copyable fix prompts, documented handoff of review findings to Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, an MCP or IDE path that exposes review comments to external agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
